All 14 design A items and 4 B items are present; 11 local suppliers were added because BHV's mean/Reiter/Følner chain has no published carrier: UCB(G) and its L¹-convolution closure, the open σ-compact subgroup, Haar semifiniteness (hidden input of BHV Exercise G.6.2, proved locally), the essential-supremum averaging and weak-star density of L¹₁₊ in the mean set, the UCB-mean→topological-mean→densities chain, the layer-cake identity, Markov–Kakutani, and fixed-point-property⇒amenability.

## Escalation (owner-held), with exact evidence
`thm-amenability-is-stable-under-closed-subgroups-quotients-and-extensions`: clauses (ii) quotients and (iii) extensions now have complete in-closure strategies (UCB pullback; the `F(g)=m_N(h↦φ(gh))` construction). Clause (i) closed subgroups does not: the source route needs `λ_G|_H ≺ λ_H` (BHV Prop. F.1.10, p. 426), whose proof is the quasi-invariant-measure/rho-function/Weil-formula computation for `G/H`, published in this library only on `induced-unitary-representations-of-locally-compact-groups` (order 1226, **outside this page's binding requires closure**). Requested amendment: add that page (or license its two published items for this pair) plus one local `λ_G|_H ≺ λ_H` item; the B page is unaffected. `validate-plan`'s `undeclared-prereq` rule forbids the dependency otherwise.
